## Mochi's Hover Colors 告别刺眼蓝色高亮！自定义辅助线和地图边界。中文详情见下方 ↓
Bright blue highlights getting in the way? Want cleaner road guides, thinner color borders, or less distracting tool previews?
**Hover Colors lets you Dim, Hide, or Change highlights, guidelines, and tool overlays so you can see your city instead of the UI.**
### Highlights
- Change highlight color, transparency, fill, and outline thickness. - **1-Click Eye button** hides/shows highlights instantly. - Works on buildings, cars, trees, citizens, props, roads, property lots, and more. - Full color picker with HEX support. - Save and quickly switch between **4 custom color presets**.
### Guidelines + Area Tools
- Change guideline colors, opacity, and line thickness. - Road Clutter Filter button: hide cost and unnecessary mouse hints. Keep angles and guide distances; slope and total length now beside your cursor. Optional toggle button: leave off if you prefer vanilla's excess tooltips when drawing roads. - Adjust Surface and Extractor border thickness. - Hide Surface and Specialized Industry preview fills. - Change District border and overlay color/opacity (one shared color for now).
### NEW: Map Borders
- Change unlocked-tile borders and outer map edge colors and opacity separately. - Adjust border width and dash size. - **1-click Eye button** to hide/show all map borders independently of hover highlights. - Reset to game defaults anytime.
### Panel + Options
- Glass or Dark panel styles. - Collapsible sections and remembered panel position. - Choose Top Left or Top Right button or Universal alone. Changes apply instantly. - Works in **Editor Mode**, use the panel hotkey to open (default J). - Extra Bulldozer and other options in the Options menu.
## Good to Know
* **To start:** click the Hover Colors palette icon. New install shows it in both Top Left plus a Universal location (paradox icon bottom right). * **Works with Recolor:** Hover Colors changes highlights, guides, overlays, and previews. Recolor changes the actual objects. * **Lightweight:** no Harmony patches and safe to remove anytime. Performance friendly, settings update when needed. * Hover over controls for quick tooltip help.
### Support + Feedback
- Support by clicking the Like 👍 button (top right) — no donations requested, just a free like for many months of work and testing. - Feedback: use the [Discord](https://discord.gg/gwXgvtyhjc) | [GitHub](https://github.com/River-Mochi/CS2-Mochi-HoverColors) icon links on this page. - PR's or code contributions are welcome. Mod is GPL-3.0-or-later license. Clones/Forks must stay GPL and credit the original, see Github for details.
### ❤️ Credits and Thanks
**Huge thanks to everyone who helped test and support.**
- River-Mochi - mod author - Flashbond - collab, tech feedback, testing - yenyang (Recolor, Anarchy) - collab, tech feedback, testing - StarQ's request: mod Boundary Lines Modifier is retired and concept added as "Map Borders" feature. - Gagaxm, Mayor Cheeks - surface-hide requests and testing - Testing: StarQ, Dx, BugsyG, ElGendo87, Maestro - =Noel= (MapExt) images and testing - rzzirrah - image consultant

### Manual Download Installs of any mod - Paradox manual downloads use a long generated folder name (not human readable). - You can safely rename this mod's folder to **HoverColors** - Don't use "+" in manually installed folder names. It can prevent mod icons and UI from loading in the city.

## Hover Colors · 高亮颜色与辅助线美化
**告别刺眼的蓝色高亮，让城市画面更清爽！**
自由调整颜色、透明度和线条粗细，也可以一键隐藏。
### 主要功能
- **高亮颜色：** 自定义建筑、车辆、树木、道路等物体的高亮颜色、描边粗细及填充透明度。 - **一键隐藏：** 随时关闭或恢复鼠标悬停高亮。 - **4 组自定义预设：** 保存喜欢的配色，随时切换。 - **道路辅助线：** 自定义颜色、透明度和线条粗细。 - **道路提示精简：** 隐藏费用和多余操作提示，保留角度和辅助线长度，坡度与道路总长度显示在鼠标旁。 - **区域工具：** 隐藏地表和专业工业区的预览填充，调整边框粗细及行政区颜色。
### 🆕 地图边界
- 分别调整已解锁地块边界和地图最外缘的颜色、透明度。 - 自由调整边界粗细和虚线大小。 - 一键隐藏或显示地图边界，不影响普通高亮。 - 随时恢复游戏默认设置。
### 使用说明
- 点击游戏左上角的调色板图标即可使用。 - 支持深色和半透明面板，可拖动、折叠。 - 支持编辑器模式，默认快捷键 J。 - 完整简体中文界面及操作提示。 - 轻量运行，无 Harmony 补丁，可随时安全卸载。
**作者：River-Mochi**
